stage_note: Challenge: a restart cannot help when the network drops TCP 7844 (every new launch hits the same timeout and only changes the public link); cloudflared already retries its own connection with backoff and keeps its hostname, so holding the process is strictly better. Risk of false 'blocked': a real dead tunnel with a reachable edge does not log 7844 i/o timeouts, so the old 10-min restart still applies; a 30-min fresh attempt bounds any mis-detection. Public-check restart (publicStale) is also suppressed while blocked, since the edge is unreachable. No new process, no machine setting, no regex.
